title: Sr. Software Engineer (Remote Eligible from Bulgaria) at Smartsheet
description_review: Senior software engineer role at a work management SaaS company, remote-eligible from Bulgaria. The core platform combines a legacy Java monolith with microservices in Java and Go on AWS, with AI agent work.
pros: Legacy Java monolith and microservices match the modernization profile
Senior role on AWS with infrastructure as code
AI agents in the product roadmap
cons: Go and Kotlin also used in the stack
SaaS product rather than banking or fintech

cons: Testing and QA focus, not product development
Leads QA team rather than backend Java services
